title: Rybakina wins US Open to inflict further pain on Sabalenka
byline: Elena Rybakina demonstrated why she is the best women’s player in the world by beating two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka to win her first US Open title.

title: India vs Sri Lanka: Asia Cup final clash set for Dubai
byline: India and Sri Lanka will battle for the Women’s T20 Asia Cup title in Dubai on Sunday, with both sides heading into the final unbeaten.

title: Vijitha Herath to visit Thailand from September 14–16
byline: Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism Vijitha Herath is scheduled to undertake an official visit to Thailand from September 14 to 16, 2026, at the invitation of Thailand’s Minister of Labour.

title: Driver injured as police open fire on van in Gampaha
byline: A van driver was injured after police opened fire at a vehicle suspected of transporting narcotics in the Asgiriya area of Gampaha last night (12), police said.

title: Heavy rains over 100mm forecast in five provinces
byline: The Meteorology Department has forecast heavy rainfall of over 100mm in some areas of the North Central, Central, Sabaragamuwa, Western and North Western provinces.

title: SJB takes fight against 22nd Amendment to Colombo streets
byline: Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa said that the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) will stage  public protest in Colombo on September 24 against the proposed 22nd Amendment to the Constitution.

title: China, India agree to strengthen ties as Xi, Modi meet
byline: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi have agreed to strengthen bilateral relations, with both leaders describing China and India as partners rather than rivals during talks on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi.

title: Rs. 2,000 fine proposed for unregistered dogs
byline: Dog owners who fail to register their animals could face a Rs. 2,000 fine in addition to the applicable registration fee under a proposed new Bill.

title: New report of attack on Strait of Hormuz shipping fans fears of threats to oil supplies
byline: Maritime trackers received new reports of an attack on a ship in the Strait of Hormuz ​on Sunday, adding to concerns about Iran-related threats to global energy supplies after Saudi Arabia shut down a vital oil pipeline.

title: New move to speed up Motor Traffic services
byline: The Department of Motor Traffic (DMT) has launched a programme aimed at reducing the time taken by the public to obtain services, Commissioner General of Motor Traffic Retired Air Vice Marshal Thushara Fernando said.

title: Firm fined over rice, expired glucose
byline: A Colombo based company has been fined Rs. 200,000 after pleading guilty to charges involving the alleged alteration of original prices on basmati rice packets and the storage of expired liquid glucose stocks, the Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) said.

title: Drought tests humanity as wildlife struggles for survival
byline: As dry conditions intensify across the country amid the effects of El Niño, the Ministry of Environment has warned of the growing challenges faced by both people and wildlife, highlighted that compassion and responsible human behaviour are essential to protect animals during the difficult period.

title: Chaminda Vaas set to join Delhi Capitals as fast bowling coach
byline: Former Sri Lanka fast bowler Chaminda Vaas is set to take over as Delhi Capitals’ fast bowling coach as the franchise reshapes its coaching staff ahead of the next IPL season.

title: ADB to provide Rs.6.7 billion for provincial health development in 2027
byline: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) is set to provide Rs.6.7 billion in capital funding in 2027 to support health sector development programmes across Sri Lanka’s nine provinces.

title: Severe lightning warning issued for several areas
byline: An Amber Advisory for severe lightning has been issued for several provinces and districts, valid until 11.30 p.m. today (13).

title: Dehiwala ‘Made in China’ footwear racket exposed
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has raided a clandestine footwear manufacturing facility in Kawdana, Dehiwala, where footwear allegedly assembled locally was being labelled as “Made in China” and supplied to reputed retail chains.

title: Best friends for decades - until a DNA test revealed they were sisters
byline: Theirs is a story straight out of a Bollywood film. Two Indian-born women in their 40s, adopted as babies by different families and raised near each other in the Netherlands, have now discovered they are biological sisters.

title: Weerawansa alleges Govt. selectively pursuing investigations
byline: National Freedom Front (NFF) leader Wimal Weerawansa alleged that the Government was selectively pursuing investigations against its political opponents while protecting individuals linked to the ruling administration.

title: Railway unions warn of Sept. 17 strike over unresolved issues
byline: Railway trade unions have warned that their planned strike on September 17 will go ahead unless the Government provides satisfactory solutions to the administrative and passenger-related issues confronting the Railway Department.

title: Businessman arrested at BIA with Rs. 6.68 mn worth of ‘Kush’
byline: A 44-year-old businessman from Weligama, Matara, was arrested yesterday by Customs officers at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) after he was allegedly found attempting to smuggle 668 grams of ‘Kush’ valued at around Rs. 6.68 million into the country.

title: Calls for Speaker to resign pending corruption investigations
byline: The Bribery or Corruption Commission should expedite investigations into allegations against Speaker of Parliament Dr. Jagath Wickramanayake to ensure an impartial inquiry, Chairman of the Doctors’ Trade Union Alliance for Medical and Civil Rights Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa said.

title: Heavy rainfall of around 100 mm expected in five provinces
byline: Heavy rainfall of around 100 mm is likely at some places in the North Central, Central, Sabaragamuwa, Western and North Western provinces today, the Meteorological Department said.

title: Air force officer, soldiers arrested over deer hunting at Mattala Airport
byline: Five individuals, including an officer and soldiers from the Mattala Air Force camp, along with two civilians, have been arrested for allegedly shooting deer roaming inside the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport grounds and selling the meat to civilians.

title: One dead, 102 rescued from Indonesian ferry that went missing in Java Sea
byline: One person has died and 102 have been rescued from a stricken Indonesian passenger ferry in the Java Sea, an official said.

title: Dense fog causes traffic disruptions in Central Hills
byline: Traffic disruptions have been reported along the western slopes of the Central Hills due to dense fog that has persisted since the early hours of today (13).

title: Severe lightning advisory issued for several areas
byline: The Department of Meteorology issued an advisory for severe lightning for Eastern, Uva, North-Central, Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Vavuniya, Mannar, Mullaittivu and Kurunegala districts.

title: Sri Lankan long-haul jet owner arrives at Ratmalana
byline: Dr. Rosh Jalagge, the first Sri Lankan to own a private long-haul jet, arrived at the Ratmalana Airport in his private aircraft, according to airport sources.

title: Rumesh Tharanga takes on world’s best in Budapest tonight
byline: Sri Lankan javelin thrower Rumesh Tharanga is set to compete in the men’s javelin throw at the World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest, Hungary, today (13), with the event scheduled to begin at 9.40 p.m. Sri Lanka time.

title: India opt to bat first against Sri Lanka in Asia Cup Final
byline: India Women have won the toss and elected to bat first against Sri Lanka Women in the Women’s Asia Cup 2026 final at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium on Sunday.

title: Family politics is now over in Sri Lanka - President
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake today said that the era of political dynasties is over, saying the practice of a President’s son succeeding him or a Prime Minister’s son inheriting the premiership belongs to Sri Lanka’s “old politics” and is not part of modern politics.

title: Three held over alleged turtle-for-money racket at Unawatuna
byline: Three men were arrested after allegedly using protected turtles to entertain foreign tourists and attempting to collect money from them at Unawatuna.

title: FitsAir suspends Colombo-Dubai flights until November
byline: FitsAir has temporarily suspended its Colombo-Dubai flight service with effect from September 6, 2026, citing the evolving situation in the Middle East region.

title: 25 nations, 5,000+ runners hit Colombo streets
byline: The Colombo Marathon 2026 concluded successfully today (September 13) at Galle Face Green in Colombo, attracting more than 5,000 local and international runners.

title: “Big boss or boss’s son - It doesn’t matter” - President
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has pledged to continue an uncompromising crackdown on corruption, drug trafficking and organized crime, while outlining a series of development and welfare measures for rural communities.

title: Dehiwala shooting suspect among five arrested in Mount Lavinia raid
byline: Five people, including two women, have been arrested during a joint search operation at a housing complex in the Mount Lavinia police area.

title: China, India agree to strengthen ties as Xi, Modi meet
byline: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi have agreed to strengthen bilateral relations, with both leaders describing China and India as partners rather than rivals during talks on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi.

title: Pathirage makes history with 91.09m victory in Budapest
byline: Sri Lankan javelin star Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage capped his remarkable season with another major victory, winning the men’s javelin at the World Athletics Ultimate Championship Budapest 26 on Sunday (13).

title: India set Sri Lanka 184-run target in Asia Cup Final
byline: India Women posted 183 for 5 against Sri Lanka Women in the Women’s Asia Cup 2026 final in Dubai, setting Sri Lanka a target of 184 runs for victory.

title: Heavy rains affect over 17,000 people across the country
byline: More than 17,000 people have been affected by adverse weather conditions reported across the country, with 10 deaths and nine injuries reported following heavy rainfall, according to the Disaster Management Centre (DMC).

title: First 3MW solar project under 300MW programme connected to national grid
byline: The first project under a programme to add 300 megawatts (MW) of renewable energy to Sri Lanka’s national electricity grid was officially connected to the grid in Veyangoda today.
